description:
Error envelope returned for every non-2xx response.

``code`` is a stable machine token (``PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND``, ``VALIDATION_ERROR``,
``INTERNAL_ERROR``); the HTTP status repeats it for convenience so a client
can branch on either. ``detail`` carries the machine-readable particulars
(for example the offending field and its limit).

example.message: Product 'B0000000000' was not found in the serving cache.

code.description: Stable error token, e.g. PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND, VALIDATION_ERROR, INTERNAL_ERROR.
code.title: Code

detail.description: Optional machine-readable particulars (unknown ASIN, failing field name and bound).
detail.title: Detail

request_id.description: Correlation id for logs, when available.
request_id.title: Request Id

title: ErrorResponse
